default.notes: A tourist visa is issued on arrival at international airports (about EUR 25) — pre-register on the official EASE platform before departure, or apply at an embassy in advance.

groups.notes: ECOWAS citizens enter freely under the Community's free-movement protocol — up to 90 days with a valid passport or ECOWAS travel document.
Visa-free for stays up to 30 days under Cabo Verde's visa waiver for Europeans — EASE pre-registration and the airport security tax still apply.
Visa-free for short stays under bilateral and CPLP (Portuguese-language community) arrangements — confirm the exact allowance before travel; EASE pre-registration still applies.

CV.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Cabo Verdean citizens.

RU.notes: Visa-free for up to 60 days under the bilateral agreement with Russia — EASE pre-registration and the airport security tax still apply.
